description: Get A/B test aggregate stats, per-variant stats and whether the winner metric difference is statistically significant (95% confidence). Supports period or custom start/end ranges.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

end.description: Custom range end as ISO 8601. Requires start.

includeMachineEngagement.description: If true, include machine-classified bot/scanner opens and clicks. Defaults to false, so metrics and activity are human-only.

start.description: Custom range start as ISO 8601. Requires end.

name: get_ab_test_stats

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_ab_test_stats` MCP tool.

abTest.description: The A/B test record returned by Sequenzy.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

significance.description: Statistical significance of the winner metric. Before a winner is selected it uses the requested time range; once a winner is selected it compares only emails sent before the winner was chosen and ignores period/start/end. status is insufficient_data (a variant has under 30 recipients or too few opens/clicks), not_significant (the difference could still be chance), or significant (confidence reached confidenceLevel). Report not_significant leaders as ahead, not as winners. Automatic winner selection does not wait for significance.

confidence.description: One minus the corrected p-value (0-1); at or above confidenceLevel the difference is unlikely to be chance. Very strong results can round to exactly 1 (report as >99.9%). Null while data is insufficient.

confidenceLevel.description: Confidence required for significant, from 0 to 1.

leaderVariantId.description: Variant with the highest rate; null when the top variants tie.

metric.description: Metric compared, from the test's winner criteria. Goal and event criteria compare whether recipients converted (goal_value too, since value has no yes/no outcome).

pValue.description: Corrected two-sided p-value; null while data is insufficient.

relativeLift.description: Leader's relative improvement over the closest variant (0.3 = 30% higher); null without a leader or when the closest variant has no opens/clicks.

status.description: Whether the leader's advantage is significant.

stats.description: The A/B test statistics record returned by Sequenzy.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

variants.description: Per-variant stats: id, label, subject, isWinner and stats.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
